title: 数据科学与机器学习项目笔记本
summary: 该项目包含作者在Nodebook数据科学与机器学习课程中完成的真实项目，涉及Python、机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI及AI Agent，展示了构建具备思考、规划和行动能力的智能系统的实践经验。
summary_en: This repository contains real-world projects from the Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program, covering Python, ML, Deep Learning, LLMs, Generative AI, and AI Agents, demonstrating hands-on experience in building intelligent systems that can think, plan, and act.
